Starting with Mario, how was he during his ban and his return to the pitch \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fnews\u002Fmario-vuskovic-returns-to-hamburg-training-after-doping-ban-hsv-hajduk-split-39192\">against Hajduk\u003C\u002Fa> at the weekend?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Merlin Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"That's not an easy question to answer, because he had a four-year ban where Mario personally had ups and downs – and so did we. What's always been clear is that he was always very focused on what he could influence. That included training every day and having that mindset of wanting to return, which he's now done. He's very fit, very focused. It's been a great week for us with a great display by Mario.\"\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: What impact will Mario have on the pitch when he eventually makes his Bundesliga return?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"That's the big unknown for us all, one that you can't really assess after four years. He'll be ready whenever we put him on. The moment I call him over to the dugout and he pulls on his jersey, I know I can fully rely on him. That's the impression I've had from day one. You feel it in the changing room and on the training ground. It's a real bonus for all of us.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: The end of November marks two years since you took charge of Hamburg. You recently signed a contract extension too. How do you reflect on your time here, what does the faith of the HSV board mean to you?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"Trust is the foundation you need to be able to work properly as a coach. That's when you know it's more than just about the result at the weekend – it's the process that matters. We've felt that from the beginning. When \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fnews\u002Fkathleen-krueger-appointed-hamburg-sporting-director-bayern-37150\">Kathleen [Krüger] took over as sporting director\u003C\u002Fa>, it was clear from the start that we had a clear vision for the club.\"\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: You didn’t have a good start to the season. The squad was only finalised late on in the transfer window, but you remained calm throughout and always reminded people to 'trust the process'. How did you manage that?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"If you focus on things you can't control, you'll find things tough. Someone once told me that if you want everyone to like you, you should become an ice cream van driver and not a football coach. I think that's quite a fitting analogy. You'll never be able to please everyone, but that's not our objective.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\"Our objective is to one day hand over Hamburg in better shape than it was when we took charge. We're well on track to do that. It's really about the things we can develop one step at a time and having a clear idea of where we want to get to, instead of listening to things that might disrupt us.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\"When people leave the stadium – whether at home or away – or if they're watching on TV, they should always feel it was worth buying the ticket ticket or tuning in. Sometimes they do, sometimes less so. That's what sport is all about, I think. Looking at the last two years as a whole, I think HSV fans have had a pretty good time.\"\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: The Nordderby is up next. How much are you looking forward to that as a Hamburg native?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"I'm so excited. From the first day of training this week – and I'm sure it'll have been the same for Bremen – you realise things are different. You realise something really special is coming up. What matters now is believing in our strengths and respecting our opponents' achievements. I think that goes without saying, given the tradition behind this fixture. Above all, what matters is going there and giving our all for HSV.”\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: It's a very special day for you and for everyone associated with Hamburg. As a Hamburg native, how do you convey to your players how big a game this is?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"We'll obviously have talks where we show them certain things, and we'll maybe do things a little differently for the Nordderby than we would for other fixtures. We don’t want to big things up too much beforehand. We just need to make sure our energy levels on Sunday make it clear that we're aware what's at stake.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\"Bremen will try to do exactly the same. When we played at home last season, we saw what can happen when you're aware of what it's all about. We also saw how being just a couple of percentage points below our best, like we were in Bremen, isn't enough. We want to do all we can to make sure we come away from Bremen with smiles on our faces.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Watch:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \u003Cem>Get set for the Nordderby\u003C\u002Fem>\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: In \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fnews\u002Fhamburg-werder-bremen-match-report-highlights-matchday-13-35108\">your last derby at home\u003C\u002Fa>, you went behind through \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fplayer\u002Fjens-stage\" data-dfl-object-id=\"DFL-OBJ-J01C07\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-00000E\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Jens Stage\u003C\u002Fa>'s goal but then hit back with an incredible Luka Vušković strike and \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fplayer\u002Fyussuf-poulsen\" data-dfl-object-id=\"DFL-OBJ-0002F6\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-00000C\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Yussuf Poulsen\u003C\u002Fa>'s first goal for the club. Does that motivate your current crop of players?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"You obviously need to make sure the players know what the derby is about. It's not really about digging out old stories, but everyone needs to know what matters. They need to know what winning a derby does to you; what losing a derby does to you. It's about more than just three points – I think everyone knows that. We don't want to play things down. Above all, it’s about being ready.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: Bremen are in good form despite losing to \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Fvfb-stuttgart\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-00000D\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">VfB Stuttgart\u003C\u002Fa> last time out. How do you plan on getting the better of them?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"They've clearly improved since our last encounter and delivered some great performances. We're aware that it isn't just about \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fplayer\u002Fniclas-fullkrug\" data-dfl-object-id=\"DFL-OBJ-0000ZM\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-00000E\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Niclas Füllkrug\u003C\u002Fa> – the whole team are playing remarkably well. They cover a lot of ground, and they strike a good balance between keeping things tight at the back and being quick and aggressive on the counter. Their maturity also means they don't fall apart after small mistakes.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Watch:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \u003Cem>What makes Füllkrug so deadly?\u003C\u002Fem>\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: Niclas Füllkrug is in excellent form. How do you go about keeping him quiet for 90 minutes?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"His qualities are clear for all to see, and the fact that he's rediscovered those qualities in Bremen says everything about his bond with the club. I think that's what the fans and the club appreciate about him.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\"He's a very powerful player in one-v-ones, but it's not just about keeping him quiet – it's about defending against Bremen as a whole. That's what we need to do to deliver a good performance.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: Hamburg’s form has been improving too. \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fnews\u002Fhamburg-borussia-monchengladbach-match-report-highlights-matchday-9-39907\">You beat Gladbach 3-1\u003C\u002Fa> in your last game before the international break. What's the mood been like ahead of the derby?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"We're a lot further along than at the start of the season. What we're struggling with at the moment are our injuries. That takes time. We were doing well and then had another dip with a few injuries. We played very well in the first half of our \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fnews\u002Fhamburg-eintracht-frankfurt-match-report-dfb-cup-pokal-hsv-burkardt-39752\">DFB Cup tie at home to Eintracht Frankfurt\u003C\u002Fa>, followed by the commanding win over Gladbach. That should give us lots of confidence to be ready for Sunday.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Watch:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \u003Cem>Hamburg's top five Nordderby goals\u003C\u002Fem>\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: Speaking of injuries, who might be back for the derby?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"The lads who haven't played much in recent weeks are likely to be available for Sunday. There are obvious absentees in \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fplayer\u002Falbert-sambi-lokonga\" data-dfl-object-id=\"DFL-OBJ-J01A3I\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-00000C\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Sambi [Lokonga]\u003C\u002Fa> and Poulsen, who definitely won't play. To be honest, it looks like the others will forget about their aches and pains for the derby.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: After the derby, you're up against \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Ffc-bayern-muenchen\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-00000G\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Bayern Munich\u003C\u002Fa>. \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fnews\u002Fhamburg-bayern-munich-match-report-highlights-matchday-20-35844\">You managed a 2-2 draw\u003C\u002Fa> in your last game against them at the Volksparkstadion. Do you still think about that game?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> “I think everyone here enjoys thinking about that 2-2 draw, because it was definitely one of our best games. Matching Bayern, not just in terms of the result but also the performance, was a special thing that the Volksparkstadion had waited a long time for. Now, though, our full focus is on the derby. On Monday – or probably Tuesday – we'll start preparing for the Bayern game.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Watch:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \u003Cem>Hamburg hold Bayern back in January\u003C\u002Fem>\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: Your fellow coach \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fplayer\u002Fvincent-kompany\" data-dfl-object-id=\"DFL-OBJ-002A4J\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-00000G\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Vincent Kompany\u003C\u002Fa> has returned from illness. He also had a successful time at HSV as a player. How happy are you that he's back?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"As a person, I'm obviously really happy for him. It wasn't an easy time. Anyone – whether they like Bayern or not – can appreciate him as a person. It's no different here, not just because he played here and had a big impact at HSV. He's just a great character.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: You’re up against your good friend Daniel Thioune on Sunday. Tell us about your friendship.\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"Whenever we've faced Bremen or \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fclubs\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-00000P\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000N5D\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Fortuna Düsseldorf\u003C\u002Fa>, I've always said that we've spent a lot of time together. We shared an office and had a lot of games together, whether in front of big crowds in big stadiums or in front of very few people on random training grounds with the U17s. That forges a connection that lasts forever.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\"I'm very grateful that he gave me the chance to join him on his journey. That'll always stay with us, regardless of the rivalry between Hamburg and Werder Bremen. We both obviously still want to win on Sunday, but the doors he opened for me will always come first.\"\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: Do you speak to each other so close to a derby?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"It was my birthday recently and we spoke then. Since then, we've both been focused on our derby preparations. We both know what this game means. I'm looking forward to speaking with him again on Sunday.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: Tell us why Hamburg will win in Bremen on Sunday.\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"We'll only win if we're at 100 percent in everything we do. We'll need to defend really well, be clinical with the chances we get, and above all keep our cool when things get heated. We want to make sure every HSV fan has a lovely Sunday evening.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: Finally, are there any coaches you regard as role models. Are you hoping to emulate any of them?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Polzin:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"I think it's more about learning from several people and incorporating things into your work. That could include a number of things. On the other hand, there are also leadership figures from other sports. I think it's the job of every coach in the world to keep their eyes open and learn things that suit your character. That's what I try to do.\"\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""}],"players":["DFL-OBJ-002G1B"],"publishedAt":"2026-11-22T08:30:00Z","slug":"merlin-polzin-interview-hamburg-nordderby-werder-bremen-bayern-40050","speakingUrl":"merlin-polzin-interview-hamburg-nordderby-werder-bremen-bayern","summary":["Merlin Polzin talks exclusively to the Bundesliga ahead of Sunday's Nordderby.","Polzin also discusses his relationship with Daniel Thioune, Mario Vušković's return and the upcoming visit of Bayern Munich.","Polzin: \"It's not just Niclas Füllkrug - the whole team are playing remarkably well.\""],"teaserAbstract":{"teaserAbstractDefault":"Hamburg coach Merlin Polzin previews Sunday's derby against Bremen and discusses his relationship with Werder boss Daniel Thioune.","teaserAbstractShort":"Hamburg coach Merlin Polzin previews Sunday's derby against Bremen and discusses his relationship with Werder boss Daniel Thioune."},"tracking":{"content_group":"Feature","no_ads":false,"no_index":false},"type":"news","teaser":"https:\u002F\u002Fassets.bundesliga.com\u002Fcontender\u002F2026\u002F10\u002Fimago1085977310h.jpg?crop=0px%2C383px%2C4000px%2C2250px"},{"author":"ext.matthew.howarth@dflnet.de","categories":["tablebl1","bundesliga","fixturesbl1"],"cisId":"CON-40046","clubs":["DFL-CLU-00000E"],"editorialAbstract":"Werder Bremen's win over Hamburg on Matchday 30 last season lifted some of the pressure at the Weserstadion near the tail end of a gruelling campaign for Die Grünweißen. How big a role does the emotional aspect play in a fixture like this? Are you able to switch off at all?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Daniel Thioune:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"I can switch off, but it's always there in the background. The international break allowed us to focus on our opponents at an early stage. The derby is something that affects people here in the city and across the whole of northern Germany. When you look back at the images from last season, you realise what it can mean to everyone when things go as well as they can.\"\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: What does the Nordderby mean to you personally? What is it about these games that makes them so special?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Thioune:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"Firstly, there's the sporting rivalry. You want to be able to say that you're number one in the north. That's the objective, I think. Then there's the tradition of these derbies. They are special moments. If you're from the region, you understand just how much tension and significance surrounds the game. That's why it's perhaps one of the most special derbies in German football.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: Your long-standing friendship and working relationship with Hamburg coach Merlin Polzin, first at \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002F2bundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Fvfl-osnabrueck\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-000014\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000002\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Osnabrück\u003C\u002Fa> then at Hamburg, obviously makes this derby even more special. How are you feeling about that?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Thioune:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"It's a special day when two friends get to face each other in the Bundesliga. For it to happen in a derby is something neither of us would have predicted several years ago. If you work hard and stay on the right track, you can certainly achieve a lot.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\"We're able to separate our personal relationship from the football side of things. We both understand what this means to our respective clubs, and I'm sure we'll both be in full derby mode. When you're in derby mode, you can put friendships to one side for 90 minutes.\"\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: Derby or not, is a friendship like that worth more than three points?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Thioune:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"I think you have to separate the two. I don't think there are many things that could ever damage that friendship or put anything between us. But we also understand our responsibilities. Merlin knows from the teams' first meeting last season just how special a victory like that can be.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\"For me, it's just about making sure that everyone who wears our colours leaves the stadium in a good mood. That's what I'm working hard towards. So I certainly have to separate the two, and I'm very good at doing that.”\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: What personal qualities do you particularly admire in Merlin?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Thioune:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"Firstly, his loyalty. He's always been a reliable colleague, but also someone I've been able to deal with on an equal footing, even though there's a bit of an age gap between us. I think that's important. I was never his mentor; we've grown together, from youth coaches to being in charge at Bundesliga clubs.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>“His meticulousness is another quality, and he also has a great memory for those special emotional moments. He's particularly good at bringing those up. Merlin has become a very, very good friend and is a wonderful person.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Watch:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \u003Cem>Bremen's top five Nordderby goals\u003C\u002Fem>\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: What are your memories of the eventful Nordderby at the Weserstadion on Matchday 30 last season, which \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fnews\u002Fwerder-bremen-hamburg-match-report-highlights-matchday-30-36958\">Werder won 3-1\u003C\u002Fa>?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Thioune:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"Pure emotion. It started as soon as I arrived at the stadium. I got goosebumps when I saw the fans' tifo before the game. The noise from our fans when we scored the first goal, then the noise from the Hamburg supporters when they entered the stadium. The silence that followed when we scored our second goal, and then the silence after our third – among the Hamburg fans at least – was fantastic to experience.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\"When you look back at the pictures of what was going on in the city after the game, you realise it has to be a motivation of ours to give our all again this weekend. There were so many little emotional moments. Perhaps it was only after that 90 minutes that I really understood just how big this derby is.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: Which of those moments stands out most? That victory was also a crucial turning point in the battle to avoid relegation, wasn't it?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Thioune:\u003C\u002Fstrong> “Yes. Looking back, we effectively secured our place in the league. I think it lifted us to 31 points, which was enough to keep us up. There was a lot of emotion involved. We were going through a difficult period.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\"Probably our only objective last season was to stay in the league, but it was incredibly important that we also won the derby, particularly after our lifeless performance in Hamburg. We delivered on that. It wasn't a great season for us, but those were probably our two best moments: securing our place in the league and winning the derby.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Watch:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \u003Cem>Bremen 3-1 Hamburg - 2025\u002F26 Matchday 30 highlights\u003C\u002Fem>\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: Werder are doing well this season and find themselves in sixth place. Have expectations changed at all?  Are Werder now aiming to impose their own style of play at home, rather than play solely with passion and emotion?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Thioune:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"It has to be a combination of both. I think our ambition must be to get as close to 100 per cent as possible, week after week. If we don't manage that, things will be difficult for us in such a demanding league. We've developed as a team, and naturally that brings higher expectations.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>“If you go seven games without losing and put in good performances against the big teams in this league, beating \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Frb-leipzig\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-000017\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Leipzig\u003C\u002Fa> at home, picking up a point at \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Fborussia-dortmund\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-000007\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Dortmund\u003C\u002Fa> and going toe-to-toe with \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Fvfb-stuttgart\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-00000D\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Stuttgart\u003C\u002Fa>, you've naturally created certain expectations among the fans – but that's our ambition. I'd rather we all leave the stadium feeling disappointed after a defeat than become indifferent to it. That's part of the process we're going through.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>“A few weeks ago, we might have accepted losing at Stuttgart. Now, I'd say we were still annoyed about it ten days afterwards. We want it to stay that way, but we also need to stay grounded and always remember where we've come from. I think people expected us to be in a very different position. Where we are now is just a snapshot in time. Of course, we want to do everything we can to keep as many teams as possible below us for as long as possible.\"\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: How happy are you with how the season has gone so far?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Thioune:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"I'm pleased that we're disappointed about losing to Stuttgart and and failing to beat \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Fsc-paderborn-07\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-00000L\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Paderborn\u003C\u002Fa> at home. I don't think anyone would have expected us to \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fnews\u002Fborussia-dortmund-werder-bremen-match-report-highlights-matchday-5-39473\">come back from 2-0 down in Dortmund\u003C\u002Fa> either. I think we thoroughly deserve our points tally and our position in the table.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\"We know where we've come from, but we also know exactly where we want to go. We want to collect 40 points as quickly as possible. There's no need to dream too much; we just have to work hard. We can set ourselves smaller targets, working towards them in blocks of games. I don't think we're overachieving at the moment, but we're putting in some good performances.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Watch:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \u003Cem>Dortmund 2-2 Bremen - highlights\u003C\u002Fem>\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: What would you say is the DNA of this Werder side, and what are the main reasons behind its success?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Thioune:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"Resilience and individual characters in the team, the fact that they keep getting responding to setbacks. We have a few players who have struggled over the past few years, who haven't enjoyed much success at their previous clubs and perhaps haven't been as appreciated as they would have liked. Here, they've found that appreciation.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\"Under different circumstances, we might have lost more of our games this season. We have that ability to come back, but we also have the quality to take games by the scruff of the neck from the outset and get three points. That was the case against \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Ftsg-hoffenheim\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-000002\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Hoffenheim\u003C\u002Fa> and Leipzig at home, and away to \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002F1-fsv-mainz-05\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-000006\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Mainz\u003C\u002Fa>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\"This team is still developing, but we have a very solid core and plenty of players who want to take responsibility and show leadership. Everyone also understands their role, whether they're on the pitch or not. I think that's what makes this team particularly special at the moment.\"\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: Niclas Füllkrug has obviously played a huge part in that success. How surprised are you by his fairytale return to Bremen?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Thioune:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"Surprised, fascinated – perhaps those aren't quite the words I'd choose. I'd say I'm impressed. I'm impressed by Niclas Füllkrug the person, having got to know him before the season started.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>“When he started to open up a little and it became clear what he still wants to achieve and what his goals were, without necessarily just looking for short-term success, that was very impressive. What he does for the team and what he gives them, and of course what he gives us as a club, is probably the best thing we could have at the moment. I think we're seeing the best version of Niclas Füllkrug we've ever seen.”\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: What makes Niclas Füllkrug so exceptional, both on and off the pitch?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Thioune:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"Those things go hand in hand. I don't think you can earn acceptance without performances, but at the same time you won't be accepted if you don't have the right character. He has both.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\"I think it's important that he's very ambitious and that he can bring the best out of people around him. He's a great guy. Plenty of people have already seen that and experienced it for themselves. I think you notice it every time you have the opportunity to talk to him.\"\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Watch:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \u003Cem>What makes Füllkrug so deadly?\u003C\u002Fem>\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: You have worked your way up as a coach through various clubs and different roles. What is it that drives you these days? Is it sporting success, working with a team on a daily basis, or perhaps the desire to keep proving yourself at the highest level?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Thioune:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"I don't want anyone to tell me what I can't do. I don't want to have limits imposed on me. The only limits should be natural ones, things I can simply no longer achieve. I won't be able to play on the football pitch again, I won't be able to play in the Bundesliga, but perhaps one day I'll have the opportunity to lead a team into Europe.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\"It's really important that when you achieve something, you don't rest on your laurels. You can keep dreaming and striving for more. That's the stage I'm at now. Am I happy with sixth place? Yes, but there's still more to achieve. More importantly, though, we need to continue our momentum. I think that would be very positive for everyone, including myself.”\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Bundesliga: Werder's sporting director, Clemens Fritz, has promised to cook you some Frikadellen (traditional German meat patties) if you win the derby. Do you trust his cooking skills?\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Thioune:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \"My trust in Clemens Fritz knows no bounds. I know what a fantastic footballer he was. I know what a good sporting director he is. What I don't know at the moment is how good his cooking skills are, but he's convinced me on the other two counts. I'll give him the opportunity to convince me of his culinary skills as well.\"\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""}],"players":["DFL-OBJ-002AEN"],"publishedAt":"2026-11-22T08:15:00Z","slug":"daniel-thioune-interview-werder-bremen-nordderby-hamburg-fullkrug-40046","speakingUrl":"daniel-thioune-interview-werder-bremen-nordderby-hamburg-fullkrug","summary":["Daniel Thioune previews Sunday's Nordderby in an interview with the Bundesliga.","The Werder Bremen boss also discusses his team's fine start to 2026\u002F27, his friendship with Hamburg coach Merlin Polzin, and Niclas Füllkrug's form.","Thioune: \"We need to continue our momentum. One involves either of \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002F2bundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Fhamburger-sv\">Hamburg\u003C\u002Fa> and \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002F2bundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Fsv-werder-bremen\">Bremen\u003C\u002Fa> and\u002For \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002F2bundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Fhannover-96\">Hannover\u003C\u002Fa>, \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Fvfl-wolfsburg\">Wolfsburg\u003C\u002Fa>, \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Fhertha-bsc\">Hertha Berlin\u003C\u002Fa>, \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002F2bundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Ffc-hansa-rostock\">Hansa Rostock\u003C\u002Fa>, \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002F2bundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Fholstein-kiel\">Holstein Kiel\u003C\u002Fa> and - of course - HSV's fellow Hamburgers, \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002F2bundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Ffc-st-pauli\">St Pauli\u003C\u002Fa>, all of whom are located in the north of Germany. But none of those fixtures is THE Nordderby. That's when Hamburg and Bremen meet.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Although the sides had met in regional football going back to 1927, the first collision of the northern powerhouses at a professional level came in the very first Bundesliga season of 1963\u002F64. In Bremen, Hamburg legend Uwe Seeler found the net, but he was upstaged by Arnold 'Pico' Schütz, who struck three times in a 4-2 Werder win to secure bragging rights in the first encounter on the national stage.\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>1971: Werder wearing Hamburg shirts\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>There is little chance of fans swapping the colours of their neighbours just 77 miles distant with the off-the-pitch rivalry fierce. But Werder did have to do just that when referee Walter Eschweiler decided their red-and-white shirts were too similar to those of Hamburg, and forced the visitors to change. With Bremen not having brought alternative shirts, they were forced to wear those of HSV. It certainly seemed to help the hosts playing a familiar-looking team as they scored twice in the second half to claim a 2-1 victory.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>1982: THAT Horst Hrubesch hat-trick\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Horst Hrubesch carried the weighty mantle of being billed Seeler's successor, but he wore it well. No player has scored more times in this fixture in the Bundesliga than the seven goals Hrubesch hit against Bremen - a tally he shares with another HSV man, Franz-Josef Hönig, and Bremen's Schütz - and three of them came on a glorious day in 1982. Well, 'glorious' if you are a Hamburg fan…\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Anyone who packed into the Volksparkstadion on that day will remember Hrubesch's hat-trick for a team coached by the legendary Ernst Happel in a 5-0 win - HSV's record Nordderby triumph - that would prove a cornerstone of the club's 1981\u002F82 title win.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Watch:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \u003Cem>When Hrubesch was behind the Bundesliga advent calendar\u003C\u002Fem>\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>2004: The double and biggest derby win for Werder\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>There is no better feeling for a football fan than watching their side romp to a derby win. When that comes in a double-winning season, all the better.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>That was the dream Bremen supporters lived in a 2003\u002F04 season that has gone down in club legend, though it is not one that Hamburg goalkeeper Tom Starke will remember with any fondness. The future \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Ftsg-hoffenheim\">Hoffenheim\u003C\u002Fa> and \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Ffc-bayern-muenchen\">Bayern Munich\u003C\u002Fa> stopper was between the posts at the Weserstadion where a Sergej Barbarez own goal to open the scoring set the tone for a miserable afternoon for HSV. Five more goals would follow as Bremen claimed their highest-ever win in the fixture.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>2008: Wiese's Kung-Fu kick\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Tensions and tempers always flare on derby day, and the Nordderby has seen its fair share of white-hot atmospheres. Bremen goalkeeper Tim Wiese tried a post-playing career conversion in pro wrestling. That perhaps explains the incredible foot-first face-high assault he carried out on Hamburg forward Ivica Olic in 2008. Not out of place in the wrestling rings Wiese would later thrive in, but (fortunately) very much a rare sight on the 'green rectangle', the Bremen custodian somehow only received a booking, and his team took the points.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Watch: \u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003Cem>The best of the Nordderby\u003C\u002Fem>\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>2009: Papierkugel-gate\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>HSV were actually having a good 2008\u002F09 campaign before it all came crashing down in the space of four Nordderbys in 19 days between 22 April and 10 May. Wiese was Bremen's shootout hero in the DFB Cup semi-final between the duo, and though Hamburg won the first leg of the pair's UEFA Cup semi-final, a ball of paper — \u003Cem>Die Papierkugel\u003C\u002Fem> — played a central role in Bremen eventually going through in the second leg.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Michael Gravgaard was about to play a simple backpass to goalkeeper Frank Rost when the ball bobbled off some rolled-up paper that had been thrown onto the pitch. The ball struck Gravgaard on the shin, went out for a corner, and Frank Baumann scored from the set piece to help take Bremen into the final.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>You can now see the Papierkugel in Bremen's club museum, the fabulously named 'Wuseum.' But despite a frustrating start to their season with three straight defeats, the Red Shorts will prove no pushovers, having recorded four wins in their last six Bundesliga outings, including a commanding \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fmatchday\u002F2026-2027\u002F9\u002Fhamburger-sv-vs-borussia-moenchengladbach\u002Fliveticker\">3-1 victory\u003C\u002Fa> over \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Fborussia-moenchengladbach\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-000004\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Borussia Mönchengladbach\u003C\u002Fa> last time out - their biggest win of the campaign so far.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Returning to Germany’s top flight after a seven-year absence, HSV continue on an upward trajectory under Hamburg-born \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fplayer\u002Fmerlin-polzin\" data-dfl-object-id=\"DFL-OBJ-002G1B\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-00000C\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Merlin Polzin\u003C\u002Fa> having picked up 12 points after nine matchdays - a significant improvement on the eight points they had at the same stage last season.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Somewhat surprisingly, \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fplayer\u002Fmiro-muheim\" data-dfl-object-id=\"DFL-OBJ-J01HP7\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-00000C\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Miro Muheim\u003C\u002Fa> is proving to be Hamburg’s now not-so-secret weapon. His three goals have all come from outside of the penalty area, with only \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fwww.bundesliga.com\u002Fen\u002Fbundesliga\u002Fclubs\u002Ffc-bayern-muenchen\" data-dfl-club-id=\"DFL-CLU-00000G\" data-dfl-competition-id=\"DFL-COM-000001\" data-dfl-season-id=\"DFL-SEA-0001KA\">Bayern Munich\u003C\u002Fa> scoring more long-distance goals than HSV in 2026\u002F27. “I practise those shots a lot,” explained the Swiss midfielder, who has proved a key asset in central areas in the final third, having racked up an assist in addition to his spectacular strikes.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Watch:\u003Cem> \u003C\u002Fem>\u003C\u002Fstrong>\u003Cem>Muheim wins October's Goal of the Month\u003C\u002Fem>\u003C\u002Fp>"],"headline":""},{"type":"paragraph","body":["\u003Cp>However, with only three of Hamburg’s 12 points coming on the road, having lost four of their five away games this campaign, Polzin and Co. will know that stopping Bremen - who have won eight of their last nine games against HSV at the Weserstadion - won’t be an easy task.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Nevertheless, Sunday’s Nordderby promises to be a captivating fixture. Not only because of the players on the pitch, but because of the coaches on the touchline. \u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Bremen’s Thioune and Hamburg’s Polzin go way back.
